entries.text: A native background image inside an OpenCode theme is parked: neither the V1 value forms (hex, ANSI 0-255, reference, dark-light, none) nor the V2 value forms (hex, transparent, dollar-reference) define any image-typed token, and three raw-verified community themes contain zero image keys.
No surveyed community theme supplies a background-image mechanism: all three install by file copy (curl, cp, or symlink into the themes directory) with no plugin, terminal setting, or image path.

Native automatic per-agent theming is parked: the V2 session hook inventory carries no agent-switch, session-start, or theme hook, switchAgent is a documented action rather than an event, and the public CLI plugin API does not register themes.
A per-agent icon or avatar in the switcher is parked: neither the V1 nor the V2 agent surface defines an icon, avatar, or glyph field.

entries.section: The six hooks that did not migrate
entries.text: Under OpenCode V2 only task-dispatcher fires; the other six locked hooks (sessionStart, preCompact, sessionEnd, longRunningProcessGuard, typescriptCheck, prettierFormat) plus the docsDisciplineGuard stay on the V1 server surface and are inert, which is a deliberate unfinished gap rather than a completed port.

Two catalog command classes failed honest and were nulled to install_cmd null with verification unverified: 36 records naming skills the upstream repository does not publish, and 623 records pointing at an awesome list with zero skill directories, of which 336 were later repointed against proven origin repositories while 287 stay null because no provable command exists.
